about: Regression floors for tests/benchmark.js (synthetic songs only). Set from the measured Version A results on 2026-11-16 (record benchmark-2026-11-16T23-28-54-396Z.json), rounded down to 3 decimals. A floor is not a target: Version A gets the key wrong on 2 of 6 songs. Raise a floor only when a change has been shown to improve the metric; never lower one without a written reason.
